title: Iman Gadzhi: build an intentional micro personal brand and monetize it with 1:1 coaching
summary: Iman explains why everyone already has a personal brand and how to make it an asset. Work backwards from what you sell, pick one platform, attract a small high-quality audience with content that gets paid to acquire clients, then monetize through info and 1:1 coaching sold to a narrow niche.

principles.text: Work backwards: decide what you sell and who your perfect client is, then build the brand to attract them.
principles.quote: we work backwards. We knew we wanted to make more money and we found something to sell to make that money. [music] And then we figured out what our perfect client looks like and then we built an intentional brand to attract more of those clients through our content.

principles.text: Optimize for audience quality and profit per follower, not follower count; a thousand right followers can be enough.
principles.quote: You do not need millions of followers to get rich with a personal brand. You just need a thousand of the right ones.

principles.text: Build niche brands per audience segment, even if that means lower views, to attract only the prospects you serve.
principles.quote: you're going to notice that the views on the business channel are significantly lower, but do I care? No, I don't care because I'm attracting the audience I want.

principles.text: Pick the platform where your ideal audience already hangs out and that plays to your skills; don't master all at once.
principles.quote: you give yourself a huge head start if you create content where your ideal audience already hangs out, where they already spend their time.

principles.text: Organic content can achieve negative cost of acquisition: platforms pay you while content sells your offer on the back end.
principles.quote: content allows you to achieve something called negative cost of acquisition.

principles.text: Be authentic and take the audience on the journey; people resonate with the journey, not a hero.
principles.quote: An audience does not resonate with a hero, they resonate with the journey.
